issue.title: Route Sync/Settings pending-upload reads through hooks
issue.body:
## Summary

SyncScreen and SettingsScreen import `getPendingUploadCount` from `db/queries` directly. Prefer existing hooks (`usePendingUploads` / thin wrappers) so UI stays behind the architecture read boundary.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] SyncScreen does not import `db/queries` for pending count (use hook or screen-local effect via hook)
- [ ] SettingsScreen logout pending check uses a shared read path consistent with hooks/services (not raw query import if avoidable)
- [ ] No behavior change to sync/logout UX
- [ ] Tests updated if existing coverage breaks

## Out of scope

Full DraftingScreen query cleanup, new state libraries.
